explanation: Kilimanjaro stands in northern Tanzania, close to the Kenyan border. Many famous photographs of it are taken from Kenya's Amboseli National Park, which helps explain the mix-up.

claims.text: Mount Kilimanjaro is in Tanzania, not Kenya.
Kilimanjaro lies in northern Tanzania, close to the border with Kenya.
Kenya's Amboseli National Park, across the border, is a well-known place to photograph Kilimanjaro.

evidence.restatement: Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest mountain, stands in north-eastern Tanzania, south of the Kenyan border.
